description: Secas is a dataset listed in Brazilian national water resources information system metadata catalogue (SNIRH), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Agência Nacional de Águas e Saneamento Básico (ANA, SNIRH). A contabilização dos eventos de secas por município utiliza como fonte primária de dados os decretos de declaração de situação de emergência e estado de calamidade pública, expedidos pelos municípios, que são divulgados no sítio da Secretaria Nacional de Defesa Civil (SEDEC). São considerados, neste caso, como eventos de secas: estiagem e seca. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are SNIRH, eventos críticos, estiagem, municípios, frequência. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-snirh-portal.
